propositions: The current per-extra matrix job layout fans out 6 cells (5 per-extra + 1 union) consuming 21 concurrent job slots, exceeding GitHub Free's 20-slot org limit and causing cascading queue delays under burst load.

A venv-loop refactor must collapse the per-extra and union jobs into one, running 7 isolation iterations (one per _optional.EXTRAS key plus mcp, plus one union) without stacking activations or using bare interpreter calls.

Each iteration must use absolute venv paths ("$v/bin/python", "$v/bin/rebar-mcp"), run an rc accumulator with continue-on-error, and validate installation + detection probes; union iteration installs [agents,eval,tracing] jointly into a single venv.

The refactor adds per-extra CI coverage for metrics (in _optional.EXTRAS but previously uncovered) while fixing the check-name mismatch in main-protection.snapshot.json that would break emergency rollbacks.

Durable test guards must assert the loop contains rc/continue/exit $rc, no activate calls, and that all _optional.EXTRAS keys are looped, preventing silent reintroduction of failure-swallowing or venv-contamination bugs.
